comments.author: @jamesdeagle
comments.text: What happens if you break the speed limit driving a car? There is a ticket, fine, loss of insurance points or even loss of a driver`s licence. That is the reality of the real world. It is not fun but it is a needed reality and everybody knows it is needed or speeding is going to cause accidents. It is extremely hard for teachers to invoke consequences today. We are all in a bind. Will the next generation be able to hold a job? James

comments.author: @EmilyKresl
comments.text: Personally I have been saying for years that the classrooms are way too big for just one teacher to handle (have you ever tried watching 20-35 kids for 8 hours?) and I know teachers have been quiet quitting for decades the only difference now is that we can all watch videos of their crash outs talking about how stressed they are. It also probably doesn't help that teachers don't have unions anymore to help them fight for their rights to compromise on changes in the system.

comments.author: @HughTube-ni6kb
comments.text:
In a 100 minute block, It's a good day if I can get 10 minutes of class focus/100 minues. 
That's Gr 8. 
They not just can't read, they REFUSE to even try. Before you tell me it's my classroom management, I've been doing this successfully for 26 years, from JK to Grade 12. I have a military background and know how to run, time, and pace instruction in a classroom.
This is not sustainable and it's not limited to the USA.

comments.author: @amyoverthetop
comments.text: It is not the pandemic.  There is no longer a social contract in the educational system where students are there to learn, teachers to be in charge, and parents and administration enforce the contract.  There is no more social contract.

comments.author: @Stacia-ep9vr
comments.text: I quit because of dangerous situations at 2 different school, over 5 years.   We attended PTSD group sessions & our own private therapists.      Parents never helped us and in some cases made the situations worse.   CPS took abuse reports and little changed.   Countless weekend hours of documenting to get my students extra help and services, resulted in almost no cooperation from parents to initiate the services.   Physical harm to myself and others, with no resolution.   Destructive behaviors prevented education.
